headline: How to make Pal Metal Ingots
title: How to Make Pal Metal Ingots in Palworld | Recipe and Furnace | Palworld Guide
video_script: Here's how to make Pal Metal Ingots in Palworld. The recipe is four Ore, two Paldium Fragments and one Pure Quartz. You craft them at an Electric Furnace or a better furnace. That furnace needs power, so build a Power Generator and assign an Electric Pal to it. Then keep the materials flowing with an Ore mining base and a Paldium Crusher. Pal Metal is used for a lot of late game gear, so start stockpiling early. What are you crafting with it? Comment below!
description: Pal Metal Ingot in Palworld: 4 Ore + 2 Paldium Fragments + 1 Pure Quartz at an Electric Furnace (or better), which needs a Power Generator run by an Electric Pal.
